title: Settings
description: Language, notifications, sign-in and your data.

banner.googleLinked: Google is now linked. You can use it to sign in.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language used on this site and in the notifications we send you.
language.label: Language

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: News and chat mentions can reach you on LINE right away. Everything else (application results, requests, reminders…) is sent by email.
notifications.autoHint: If you've linked LINE and added the AIS Alumni Committee as a friend, news and chat mentions come on LINE; otherwise by email.
notifications.emailOnlyHint: News and mentions come by email too.
notifications.rule: All other notifications are sent by email, whatever you choose here.
notifications.app: 📱 Notifications go to the app ({devices}). While app notifications are on, we send them there instead of LINE or email (security notices and application results are emailed too). Turn them off in the app's settings to get LINE or email as set below.

line.title: LINE
line.description: Get news and chat mentions on LINE. Other notifications come by email.
line.notFollowing: Not following the AIS Alumni Committee
line.emailOnlyNote: You chose email only, so LINE is not used for notifications.
line.linkPrompt: Link LINE to sign in with it and receive notifications there.

methods.title: Sign-in methods
methods.description: Ways you can sign in to this account. At least one must remain.
methods.emailHint: A one-time code sent to {email}. Always available.
methods.removeLineNote: Removing LINE also stops LINE notifications.
methods.cannotRemoveLast: You can't remove your last sign-in method.
methods.addLineHint: Link LINE in the LINE section above.
methods.notReadyHint: This method isn't ready yet. We'll let you know when it is.
methods.googleInApp: Google can't be added inside the app (a Google restriction). Open the website in your browser to add it.

email.title: Email address
email.description: Your primary email, used for sign-in codes and important notices.
email.changed: Your email is now {email}. We've let your old address know.

errors.invalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.taken: That email address is already used by another account. If it's yours, contact the committee to merge accounts.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Please request a new one.
errors.tooMany: Too many wrong attempts. Please request a new code.

export.title: Download your data
export.description: Get a copy of the personal data we hold about you (JSON file).

deactivate.title: Deactivate account
deactivate.description: Hide your profile and stop all notifications. Your data is kept, and the committee can reactivate your account if you ask.
deactivate.confirmText: Are you sure? You will be signed out and won't be able to use the site until the committee reactivates you.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: Permanently delete your account and all your data, including uploaded files. This cannot be undone.
delete.wordMismatch: Please type the confirmation word exactly.
delete.soleAdminContent: You are the only admin and you created events or news. Please appoint another admin first.
delete.failed: We couldn't delete your account. Please try again.

methodRemoved.subject: A sign-in method was removed
methodRemoved.text: {method} was removed as a sign-in method for your AIS Alumni account. If this wasn't you, please contact the committee right away.

emailChangedOld.subject: Your AIS Alumni email address was changed
emailChangedOld.text: The email address for your AIS Alumni account was changed to {email}. This address will no longer receive messages. If this wasn't you, please contact the committee right away.

emailChangedNew.subject: Your AIS Alumni email address was updated
emailChangedNew.text: {email} is now the email address for your AIS Alumni account.

deactivated.subject: Your AIS Alumni account was deactivated
deactivated.text: Your account has been deactivated at your request. Contact the committee if you'd like to reactivate it.

deleted.subject: Your AIS Alumni account was deleted
deleted.text: Your AIS Alumni account and its data have been permanently deleted. Thank you for being part of the community.

stagePrompt.subject: Is your status still up to date?
stagePrompt.text: It's a new school year! Is your current status still "{stage}"? Please update or confirm it on your profile.
stagePrompt.textNoStage: It's a new school year! Please tell your classmates what you're doing now by setting your current status on your profile.
stagePrompt.history: Your current status shows as “{stage}”. If you've changed school or job, please update your schools & work.
stagePrompt.historyNoStage: Add your schools & work so your current status shows and people from the same places can find you.

methodAdded.subject: A new sign-in method was added
methodAdded.text: {method} was added as a sign-in method for your AIS Alumni account. If this wasn't you, please contact the committee right away.

adminMode.title: Admin mode
adminMode.description: You have a special role. Switch to admin mode to open the pages for what your role lets you do.

access.admin: Committee admin (verification, members, events, news, stats and more)

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Deactivate or delete your account. Please read each option carefully first.

schoolEmail.title: School email (work)
schoolEmail.description: Teachers and staff: confirming your @aisnagoya.net address shows you work at AIS. It's separate from your sign-in / notification email and isn't used for either.
schoolEmail.requiredNote: Required for current staff. It's separate from your sign-in / notification email and isn't used for either.
